notes: The merged time zone fix of accept-tzd-offset-at-instant, which subtracts getOffset(instant) instead of getRawOffset() so daylight saving time is honoured, written with the formatted time in a String local and a leading failure message: assertEquals("formatted time", "2019-06-15 12:13:14.000", formatted). In org.junit.Assert the message comes first, so the assertion still compares the same expected literal with the formatted time, now computed the fixed way: kind 1 of the strict assertion principle, accepted with no code. Read with the message in the last position, the String local would be taken for a message and the two literals for the compared values, a false reject. Adapted: the fix is the source pull request's own; the local and the message are hand written on its pre image, and every context and removed line is that file's own.
